title: Melanoma analyses link mutation subtypes to distinct tumor immune signatures
summary: Cross-cohort AI analysis linked melanoma mutation subtypes to distinct immune landscapes and implicated CCNE1; cell-line knockdown provided functional support.
ai_technology: Machine learning survival models, including regularized regression and tree-based methods
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: Four expression cohorts plus cell-line functional validation; retrospective data and in-vitro support do not establish treatment efficacy.
evidence.unknown: The four-cohort analyses and cell-line knockdown do not establish treatment efficacy in patients.
evidence.ai_role: The study compared learned survival models to identify an inflammatory signature and nominate CCNE1 from melanoma datasets.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
